subject: cartitem-product-id
detail: B stores CartItem.productId as a String with no Product model; the kept catalog is A's, whose Product.id is Integer. B's cart rows cannot point at A's products without conversion
solutions: Integer product_id with a real foreign key to products.id (A's keys kept)
Re-key A's products to uuid strings to match B
recommended: Integer product_id foreign key to products.id; A's catalog keeps its ids; B's text product ids are not carried over

subject: checkout-client-prices
detail: B's /api/checkout passes request line_items to Stripe unchanged, so a customer can pay any price they choose
solutions: Build line items on the server from the cart and catalog prices
recommended: Server-built line items from the session user's cart and Product.price; the request carries no items or prices

subject: no-identity-system
detail: No source has sign-in: A and B carts have a user_id with no User model, and C's reviews need a customer, but no source shows how users authenticate
solutions: Add one minimal accounts module (email + password, slow hash, server session in an http-only cookie)
Use an external identity provider the user chooses
recommended: One minimal accounts module (customer and shop-owner roles) built new for the unified app; it is platform, not a source feature

subject: purchase-confirmation
detail: C shows reviews only after a confirmed purchase, but B keeps no order and never confirms payment (no webhook)
solutions: Add an Order entity marked paid by a verified Stripe webhook; the review gate reads it
recommended: Order (pending -> paid) written at checkout and confirmed by a signature-verified Stripe webhook; reviews require a paid order containing the product

subject: cartitem-quantity
detail: B stores CartItem.quantity as text; A (and any sensible cart) types it as Integer. Unvalidated text quantities can be non-numeric or negative
solutions: Integer quantity with a positive check on the server
Keep text and parse it on every read
recommended: Integer quantity >= 1, checked on the server; B's existing cart rows are not migrated (see migration plan)

subject: reviews-path
detail: Reviewly documents /v2/products/{productId}/reviews; A and B use unversioned /api/... paths
recommended: Unversioned /api/products/{id}/reviews; Reviewly's path is not copied
